scope: 46 bilingual engine roll-caption templates, stock modifier notes, common action labels, hazard frames and seven prismatic colors. Proper/authored names and unknown prose are retained. This is not an audit of every generated roll detail.
provenance: Original Chinese drafts compared to repository English names and engine caption/modifier generators. No proprietary Chinese rulebook translation used; original source licenses are retained. Not independent human approval.
contextReview: Red/green/blue are colors in this namespace, distinct from dragon ancestry names. Unseen actor stays 未现身者, without assuming it is a spellcaster. Spell/equipment and damage terminology reuse the existing catalogs; dice, signs, feet, AC and proper names remain intact.

englishGolden.capture: Captured actual English RollCard renders before changing the caption formatter, Chinese catalog or owned JSX. Original English rendering functions were unchanged; typed factories were additive. All 19 previous compressed baselines remain unchanged.

saveCaptionIntegration.review: Inspected the source diff: only the roll-labels import and existing enemy save record gain additive typed source metadata. All blast calculations, save flags/DCs, English detail strings and the 46 previous roll messages remain unchanged. Original 25 English component renders and prior golden bytes are retained.

sourceBoundFollowupReview.review: Compared full diffs against Git versions reproducing each prior hash. Changes add native source-bound feature/option/background/archetype display, homebrew name guards, opt-in spell/monster help sections, and a shared English free-cast label helper. Death messages now persist typed campaign-locale events while model-facing notes and engine outcomes remain English/unchanged; condition tick avoids duplicating the wake message. Original frozen output files are unchanged. Larger feat-choice/level-up diffs and glossary history remain separately open; this source review does not claim final acceptance.

reactionFrameReview.review: Added two display-only exact engine frames for repeated attacks and disadvantage rerolls. Native feature/option names reuse source-reviewed name catalogs; ambiguous option names and unknown authored frames remain original. English formatter, roll persistence, dice and engine outcomes unchanged; original 25 English goldens retained.

pairedFeatureReview.review: Reaper HP-cost roll adds named display metadata to its unchanged English detail. Exact native feature plus spell pairs project only when both names are recognized; unknown authored pairs remain unchanged. Existing real-engine test now asserts two targets share one slot, cost expression 2d8, total 6 and exact HP deduction, Chinese caption and original English formatter parity. This is local engine evidence, not deployed-model acceptance.
